basic_profile.bio: A long-time skateboard enthusiast from Brooklyn, NY, who transitioned into electric skateboards about a decade ago. Passionate about DIY projects and tech advancements in personal transportation. Works as a freelance graphic designer and enjoys late-night rides across the city. Typically online during the evening hours, especially active on weekends. Single, with a keen interest in exploring different subcultures online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: An avid self-learner with a background in graphic design and a deep interest in electronics and mechanics. Learned about electric skateboards through online communities and personal experimentation. Regularly engages with tech forums and tutorial videos to expand knowledge.
